description: Observed after open_note_by_title in trace omninotes-share-1.
After create_note, the editor is closed and the saved note card is visible on the notes list, satisfying open_note_by_title's notes-list and visible note_title row preconditions.
The created note's title can supply open_note_by_title's note_title input.
The created note's title and content can supply invoke_share_chooser_for_note's note_title and note_content inputs; the note detail screen still has to be opened first.
After create_note, the notes list contains the new note row, satisfying archive_note's active-list and target-note row preconditions before using the detail overflow menu.
The created note's title can supply archive_note's target_note input.
After create_note, the app is back on the notes list screen, satisfying search_notes_by_keyword's notes-list/menu_search precondition.
The created note title or content can be used as the keyword input to search for that note.
open_note_by_title leaves the note detail screen with detail_title, detail_content, and menu_share available, which are the prerequisites for the share chooser action.
open_note_by_title exposes the note detail screen and the '更多选项' overflow control needed by archive_note.
A submitted search leaves a filtered visible notes list; if the keyword is a title, that matching note_title row is available for open_note_by_title.
A filtered active notes list can expose the matching target_note row needed by archive_note.
archive_note returns to the active notes list and closes the detail/overflow UI, satisfying create_note's list/no-active-editor precondition.
archive_note returns to the active notes list with TextView text='笔记' displayed, where remaining note rows can be opened by title.
archive_note returns to the active notes list, enabling a new search from the notes-list screen.
